uncertainObservations: The number of swords in the figure's arms is my least certain reading. The hilts overlap and sit against a dark cloak; I can distinguish what look like three pommel/crossguard groups, but two or four is possible. Recorded as 3 with low confidence rather than guessed higher.

I cannot confirm that the carried objects are swords rather than staffs or spears; I can see crossguard-like forms at the top and tapering blades below, which is why I call them swords, but the blades fade into shadow.
The two planted uprights at left and right are clearly blade-shaped with crossguards, but I cannot see their points entering the ground on the left one.
The two structures read as stone pyramids, but they could equally be steep tents or roofed shelters; the surface texture is ambiguous.
The figure's head is turned back and down but I cannot read any facial features or confirm the direction of the eyes.
Whether there is anything inside the two dark doorways is not resolvable.
The pale glow on the back wall has no visible source; I cannot tell if it is moonlight, a fire out of frame, or a window.
